GEN01.title: General conditions
GEN01.text: This policy is subject to the General Conditions of the Humongous Business Combined policy wording HBC-W-2024. The insured must take all reasonable precautions to prevent loss, damage and injury.

GEN02.title: Premium payment
GEN02.text: Cover is conditional on payment of the premium to the broker within 30 days of inception.

MD01.title: Material damage basis
MD01.text: Buildings are insured on a reinstatement basis. Stock is insured at cost price. Sums insured are subject to the average condition.

MD05.title: Minimum security
MD05.text: All external doors must be secured by a five lever mortice deadlock and all accessible windows by key operated locks whenever the premises are closed for business.

MD07.title: Intruder alarm condition
MD07.text: The intruder alarm must be set whenever the premises are unattended and maintained under a contract with an NSI or SSAIB approved company.

MD12.title: Flood excess
MD12.text: The excess for loss or damage caused by flood is 2,500 for each and every loss.

MD14.title: Subsidence excess
MD14.text: The excess for loss or damage caused by subsidence, heave or landslip is 1,000 for each and every loss.

MD20.title: Unoccupancy
MD20.text: Cover for theft, malicious damage and escape of water ceases if the premises are unoccupied for more than 30 consecutive days unless agreed by underwriters.

BI01.title: Gross profit basis
BI01.text: Business interruption is insured on a gross profit basis for the indemnity period shown in the schedule.

EL01.title: Employers' liability limit
EL01.text: The limit of indemnity is 10,000,000 inclusive of costs, any one occurrence, reduced to 5,000,000 for acts of terrorism.

EL04.title: Heat application
EL04.text: The insured must comply with the heat application conditions when using any blow lamp, torch or welding equipment away from the premises.

PL01.title: Public liability limit
PL01.text: The limit of indemnity shown in the schedule applies any one occurrence and in the aggregate for products.

PL03.title: Work at height
PL03.text: No cover applies for work at a height of more than 10 metres above ground level.

PL08.title: Food hygiene
PL08.text: The insured must hold a current food hygiene rating of 3 or above.
